files.description: folder with the session's files, relative to this file

start_file.description: file open in the side panel before any scene sets one

disclaimer.description: short note shown on scenes with disclaimer: true

libs.description: JavaScript libraries (local files, relative to this file) loaded into the page before the animations, e.g. libs/three.min.js; record each library's licence in sources.md

assets.description: folder of SVG and image files the animations use (default: assets, next to this file); record each source in sources.md

role.description: where this scene sits in the story template

msg.description: session message the background scrolls to

highlight.description: exact words from that message, highlighted in gold

veil.description: how much the background is dimmed behind panels (default 0.6)

file.description: session file shown in the side panel from this scene on

cite.description: extra messages / files where this scene's numbers come from

layout.description: panels on top of each other; side by side in 16:9; or side: the first panel (e.g. an animation) on the left and the others stacked to its right in 16:9

say.description: spoken words; numbers and units in words

text.description: use | for line breaks, **x** for gold words

weight.description: split only: share of the bar (defaults to the value)

max.description: value of a full-width bar (default: largest value)

badge.description: black pill after the bars, e.g. thrust ÷ weight = **1.78**

csv.description: file name in the session's files

where.description: keep rows where column == value, e.g. {"task": 1}

scale.description: multiply values, e.g. 0.001 for N -> kN

x_label.description: unit after x ticks, e.g. s

marks.description: labelled dots on the first series

script.description: the .js file, relative to video.json, e.g. anims/stand.js

data.description: CSV files from the session the drawing reads with k.data(name)

use.description: shared .js files (relative to video.json) run before the script, for a subject or setup drawn in several scenes, e.g. anims/stand.js

size.description: canvas shape (default wide); slim = a narrow subject beside cards in 16:9, a short strip above them in 9:16; band = a short, wide strip (e.g. under a title)
